message.content: {"note_claim": "The second image shows the breakup of Space Shuttle Columbia during its 2003 reentry, not Artemis 2.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "On February 1, 2003, Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrated as it re-entered the atmosphere over Texas and Louisiana, killing all seven astronauts on board.", "reason": "The Wikipedia page confirms that Space Shuttle Columbia broke apart during reentry on February 1, 2003, directly substantiating the note's claim that the image depicts Columbia's 2003 breakup."}

parsed.note_claim: The second image shows the breakup of Space Shuttle Columbia during its 2003 reentry, not Artemis 2.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On February 1, 2003, Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrated as it re-entered the atmosphere over Texas and Louisiana, killing all seven astronauts on board.
parsed.reason: The Wikipedia page confirms that Space Shuttle Columbia broke apart during reentry on February 1, 2003, directly substantiating the note's claim that the image depicts Columbia's 2003 breakup.
